No checkpoints were marked 'present' when they were only partially visible or ambiguous.
artifact_review: The Router identified a 'texture_anomaly' at the water line (severity 1.5) and 'perspective_distortion' in the background (severity 0.5). The Perceptual Quality Auditor added a 'compression' artifact (severity 0.2). I agree with these findings. The water-whale interface shows slight softness typical of generative models struggling with fluid dynamics boundaries, but it is not a catastrophic failure. The background blur is consistent with depth-of-field but lacks optical realism. The severity ratings are appropriate; these are minor imperfections in an otherwise coherent image.
alignment_reasoning: The Fine-Grained Classifier strongly confirms the class (Logit 7.65 vs 3.75 for next best), validating the distinctive dorsal knuckles and skin mottling.
